name: beyond-legacy
description: Beyond Legacy — inventory decisions for convenience stores (web + Android, Firebase).

scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix web run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --project demo-beyond-legacy --only auth,firestore,hosting "node tests/e2e.mjs"
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting,firestore
